name: What is the typical cost range for a garage addition in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for a garage addition in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a garage addition in Las Vegas can vary significantly based on factors like size, materials, foundation requirements, and whether it includes features like insulation, electrical work, or plumbing. A basic single-car garage addition might start around $20,000 to $30,000, while a larger, more customized two-car garage with enhanced finishes could range from $40,000 to $70,000 or more. Obtaining a detailed estimate from a local contractor is the best way to understand the specific costs for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a garage addition in Las Vegas typically range from $20,000 to over $70,000, depending on size, materials, and features. A detailed estimate is recommended.
